items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: I remember when I was playing with Earl Crumbs out of suburban gardens

ctx.x: the 20s here and not not very popular they were out they were out even back in 19 I'm not sure I was

about to say in the series robot catalog around 1910 I thought I remembered but I'm not quite sure whether it was in that catalog or later I do remember the first time I saw a trumpet in series robot catalog and I remember thinking how ugly it looked it looked like a bugle you know stretched out cornet and I thought it was ugly and I still think it's ugly I think a beautifully made cornet is much prettier than a trumpet and of course I like the sound of it too it goes without saying so I always had a cornet along…
was playing with Earl Crum at the same time. What years did you work with them? Can you remember
